title: Green SM (Vingroup's electric cab company) gets a Karnataka aggregator licence valid until September 2031 (Karnataka On-Demand Transportation Technology Aggregators Rules, 2016; transport officials to Moneycontrol), clearing its Bengaluru entry; owns its fleet and employs its own drivers; Indian fleet includes the 7-seat VinFast Limo Green; Delhi-NCR since June 2026, then Hyderabad; no Bengaluru fares/start date announced; Karnataka 2024 app-cab fares ₹100 first 4 km + ₹24/km (cars up to ₹10 lakh) to ₹130 + ₹32/km (above ₹15 lakh), no surge; unions Karnataka Rajya Chalakara Parishath and Peace Auto Union seek a licence review
